intro: Malta is a parliamentary republic and the smallest member of the European Union.

chapters.title: Parliament and president
text: The House of Representatives chooses the prime minister, and the president, elected by parliament, is head of state. Malta's constitution declares it neutral. It uses the euro.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: The 2017 murder of investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia exposed concerns about corruption and led to big protests.
